actionAdapters.when: 已冻结 Player 构建输入；该 Action 当前未在 MCP ExposurePolicy 中，必须返回 blocked

allow: confirmed local Player output path or platform project directory
documented build-processor staging, markers and generated platform files
temporary Build Settings, Android output and signing values restored by existing adapters
deny: unrelated source, Scene, Prefab or generated output
CDN, store upload and any remote release write
Git commit or push and UPM publish

requiredFor: 覆盖已有 Player 或平台工程输出
Android DevelopmentBuild 与 AAB 组合
读取或临时应用签名凭据
delete, external write, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认绑定 Target、Scene 闭包、输出路径、BuildMode、DevelopmentBuild、DevelopMode 和平台专属选项；任一输入改变后旧确认失效。

evidence: 冻结的 Target、Build Settings Scene、输出路径与两类构建模式
本次本地 Player 或平台工程产物
临时 Build Settings、YooAsset staging 与签名值的恢复结果
未执行真机、商店、CDN、Git 与 UPM 发布的边界说明
